'''''Loggan Squadron''''' was a small [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] of 3 [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]] employed by [[Nami]] [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime Lord]] [[Ali Tarrak]]. After [[Battle of Yrrna|demonstrating]] to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] the power of the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]]. Tarrak sent a [[Strike-class medium cruiser]] ''[[Nuance]]'' to arrange a trading agreement to a Rebel [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|Carrack cruiser]] [[Prism]]. Then, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] sent two [[Missile Boat]]s, one of which piloted by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], in their first [[Battle of the Eva-T system|mission]] to capture and reclaim TIE Defenders from the Rebels. After [[Gorgg Squadron]] was destroyed the ''Nuance'' launched the other T-wing squadrons such as '''Loggan Squadron''' [[Kurtang Squadron]] and [[Vedorr Squadron]]. All squadrons were destroyed in the end and the cruiser was captured.
